gde_conflict_sets.observation: Event 20161 contains no top-level timing keys and track_functions=none, while input_readiness_runs contains stage duration fields.
Latest pre-cutoff revisions 5.13 and 5.13.1 have overlapping screens but materially different stage-duration distributions and zero-duration prevalence.

barinel.reason: No justified component spectra with independent pass/fail outcome probabilities; ranking by likelihood would be fabricated.

information_gain.selected_query: Compare 5.13 vs 5.13.1 on overlapping pantalla_id and constant family_count before any aggregate speed conclusion.
information_gain.reason: It directly tests cohort mismatch at low read-only cost.

queries.result_summary: Event 20161 usage_stats has track_functions=none, ig_stat_rows=0, and no top-level timing/duration/elapsed/latency keys.
Provenance receipt 38 is VERIFIED for SOAK quality history: 13 screens, 47 families, zero known false PASS signals and zero unresolved D4; it contains no latency distribution.

ig_direct_requests_v1 has six rows before cutoff with e2e_ms from 46,596.626 to 322,785.297; consumers are STORY_CREATOR/MANUAL and last_status is BLOCKED, so they are not a qualified Curator/Validator benchmark cohort.
current_setting('track_functions')=none; curator/validator-related pg_stat_user_functions call/total/self times are NULL. Missing stats cannot support zero-usage or speed claims.
input_readiness_runs contains curator_completed_at, validator_completed_at, curator_duration_ms and validator_duration_ms, allowing direct pre-cutoff stage analysis.

255 runs before cutoff; curator duration known in 248 and validator in 233. Zero durations: curator 75, validator 99. Positive-only p50/p90: curator 28,148/115,850.6 ms; validator 78,758.5/257,428.6 ms.
By status: BLOCKED=20 (validator durations all NULL), COMPLETED=233 (curator zero=75, validator zero=99), CURATING=2 (both durations NULL).
For COMPLETED zero-duration rows, wall-clock deltas computed from stage timestamps are also exactly 0 ms; zero values are internally timestamp-consistent, not demonstrably corrupted.

Contract revisions vary sharply. Revision 5.13: 86 completed, curator positive p50/p90 23,915/45,223 ms, validator 69,597/155,020.2 ms. Revision 5.13.1: 20 completed, curator 60,257.5/136,648.4 ms, validator 246,293/408,971.6 ms; zero counts also differ.

5.13 covers 42 screens, 5.13.1 covers 16, all 16 overlap and family_count remains 47 in shown rows. Many overlapping screens have higher positive stage medians in 5.13.1, but per-screen n is often 1-2 and zero-duration handling differs.

findings.claim: Event 20161 and pg_stat_user_functions cannot substantiate a speed claim; function statistics are unavailable because track_functions=none.
Pre-cutoff input_readiness_runs contains usable stage-duration evidence, but aggregate comparison is confounded by revision mix and a large exact-zero cohort.

A naive latest-revision improvement claim is not supported: on the 16 overlapping screens, 5.13.1 commonly shows larger positive stage times than 5.13, but sample sizes and zero-duration handling prevent a causal regression conclusion.
SOAK receipt 38 certifies quality-history conditions, not end-to-end or stage latency.

negative_falsifiers.hypothesis: Zero pg_stat rows prove no Curator/Validator calls.
Zero duration rows are demonstrably inconsistent with their timestamps.

alternatives: Different execution path or workload despite same family_count
Selection bias from only 16 overlapping screens and low per-screen n

minimal_safe_action: Build a same-screen, same-path, same-revision-transition cohort using only positive qualified durations and explicitly model zero-duration semantics before accepting or rejecting the performance optimization.
unresolved: Semantic meaning of exact-zero stage durations by revision
Whether 5.13.1 changed execution path or only instrumentation
Qualified end-to-end denominator linked to the same Curator/Validator runs
Statistical significance with matched repeated observations
